title: Omega-3 Fatty Acids and Insulin Sensitivity

sections.abstract:
This study is being done to understand the effects of dietary omega-3 fats on insulin sensitivity in adult men and women.

Posted outcomes: Insulin Sensitivity by Hyperinsulinemic-euglycemic Clamp at Baseline and 6 Month Follow up. timeframe=Baseline, after 6 months of treatment. Omega-3=10.92 (±1.04); Placebo=10.39 (±0.76)
